description: Stunning loft with a glass roof in the heart of Paris, a stone's throw from Notre-Dame. Bright, quiet and stylish, with a large living room and a fully equipped open-plan kitchen. Located in the Latin Quarter, you will benefit from numerous restaurants, traditional cafés, bakeries, markets and supermarkets within walking distance. Right nearby: the Seine, Île Saint-Louis, the Louvre and the Marais are all within walking distance. Saint-Michel, Maubert-Mutualité and Jussieu metro stations.The spaceThe apartment offers an elegant and comfortable layout with 4 bedrooms:• Bedroom 1: double bed (140 x 190 cm)• Bedroom 2: queen-size bed (160 x 200 cm), convertible to twin beds• Bedroom 3 (suite): queen-size bed with en-suite bathroom (shower, washbasin, toilet)• Bedroom 4 (suite): 2 single beds (90 x 200 cm) with en-suite bathroom (bath, washbasin, toilet)Bedrooms 1 and 2 share a bathroom with a shower and washbasin, with a separate toilet.An ideal arrangement that combines comfort, privacy and flexibility, perfectly suited for stays with family or friends.Guest accessThe flat is at the guests’ full disposal during their stay. You will have the entire property to yourselves, in a comfortable and fully equipped setting.
